dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good news, Nam! The company is going to let us work from home on Fridays.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈnuːz, ˈnɑːm! ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈlɛt ʌs ˈwɜːrk frəm ˈhoʊm ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? That's great. My commute takes an hour and a half each way.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ðæts ˈɡreɪt. maɪ kəˈmjuːt ˈteɪks ən ˈaʊər ənd ə ˈhæf ˈiːtʃ ˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And office hours will be more flexible. We can start any time between seven and ten.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈɔːfɪs ˌaʊərz wɪl bi ˈmɔːr ˈflɛksəbəl. wiː kən ˈstɑːrt ˈɛni ˈtaɪm bɪˈtwiːn ˈsɛvən ənd ˈtɛn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They are. When I started here, they made us stay until eight every night.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈɑːr. wɛn aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈhɪr, ðeɪ ˈmeɪd ʌs ˈsteɪ ənˈtɪl ˈeɪt ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Were you made to work on Saturdays, too?
dialogue.reading: wɜːr juː ˈmeɪd tə ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪz, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sometimes. And we were made to come to the office for every meeting.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ənd wiː wɜːr ˈmeɪd tə ˈkʌm tə ði ˈɔːfɪs fər ˈɛvri ˈmiːtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Now we have online meetings most of the time. I can join from anywhere.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaʊ wiː ˈhæv ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈmiːtɪŋz ˈmoʊst əv ðə ˈtaɪm. aɪ kən ˈdʒɔɪn frəm ˈɛniwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I hope they don't make us turn on our cameras at eight in the morning!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðeɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈmeɪk ʌs ˈtɜːrn ɑːn aʊr ˈkæmərəz ət ˈeɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! Then wear a nice shirt with your shorts. No one will know!
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈðɛn ˈwɛr ə ˈnaɪs ˈʃɜːrt wɪð jʊr ˈʃɔːrts. ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn wɪl ˈnoʊ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: True! Flexible hours and no commute on Fridays. I might start to love this job again!
dialogue.reading: ˈtruː! ˈflɛksəbəl ˈaʊərz ənd ˈnoʊ kəˈmjuːt ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪz. aɪ maɪt ˈstɑːrt tə ˈlʌv ðɪs ˈdʒɑːb əˈɡɛn!
